# Checklist

- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have created a PR title which is short, sweet, and descriptive.
- [ ] I have created a branch following the required naming convention. Ex. RP-668-add-service-method
- [ ] I have linked a Linear issue which references this work if not included in the branch name.
- [ ] I have completed the Pull Request Description with all applicable information.
- [ ] I have requested a review from the Revenue & Payments team on Slack in #order-fulfillment-domain using @revenue-and-payments-tech.

See [Order Fulfillment Domain: How We Work](https://xometry.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/MSD/pages/6896484444/Order+Fulfillment+Domain+How+We+Work#Pull-Requests-and-Branches) for more details.

## Pull Request Description

### :rotating_light: Sox

If unsure, check the [Xometry SOX Change Control Guidelines](https://xometry.atlassian.net/wiki/x/3AGNcAE?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNTU0ZGNjOTI2YjViNDI2Zjk4ZWE4MTgwZTFmZGNmMzMiLCJwIjoiYyJ9).

- [ ] Yes - Add the SOX Label
  - [ ] Financial Impact - Minor
  - [ ] Financial Impact - Moderate
  - [ ] Financial Impact - Major
- [ ] No

### Pull Request Type

- [ ] :rocket: New Feature
- [ ] :wrench: Infrastructure Changes
- [ ] :bug: Bug

### 1. Summary and Rationale
- Provide a quick summary of the changes.
- Explain the impact and intent behind these changes.
- This section should be self-contained and not just refer to a ticket.

### 2. Links to Additional Resources
- Include any related issues, documentation, or other resources.
- Screenshots or images can be added if applicable.
- (Note: If the branch name includes the ticket number, it is automatically linked, so no need to repeat it here.)

### 3. Change Breakdown
- Use bullet points to detail:
  - What changed
  - Why it changed
  - How it was changed

### 4. Testing
- Describe how the changes were tested.
- Include any relevant screenshots or notes about the testing process.

### 5. Out-of-Scope Work
- Specify any related work not covered in this PR but planned for future consideration.
